purpose: Verify whether platform delta can be merged into the existing single character movement pass. Vertical candidates were deliberately rejected before author schema implementation.
conclusion: Only horizontal motion was admitted. Animatable vertical movement alternated grounded state and lagged the support; transform/server updates did not repair it. Static-body control lost upward one-way support. Horizontal reversal, jump detachment and scoped drop-through worked.
fixtureRepair: First launch omitted asset import and failed to load SVG. Import was added before evaluating physics; ordinary-solid comparison removed its inapplicable drop-through author binding. These were probe setup failures, not product regressions.
